summary: Variables can go directly on hosts and groups in inventory, but separate host_vars and group_vars files via the default host_group_vars plugin are more robust.
questions: Where should I define host and group variables?

answer_card.title: Where to put inventory variables
answer_card.answer_md: You can add variables directly to hosts and groups in a YAML or INI inventory. A more robust approach is separate files in `host_vars/` and `group_vars/`, loaded by the default `host_group_vars` vars plugin.
